targets.title: Emotional intelligence is a second-stratum factor of intelligence: Evidence from hierarchical and bifactor models.
targets.evidence_quote: Based upon the problematic status of the MSCEIT and the psychometric properties of the data it produces, the current study presents a conceptual replication of the MacCann et al. (2014) analyses from data collected using alternative non-proprietary measures.
